title: Imputation of Public Opinion Data with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.09351v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely evaluated as simulators of survey responses, yet applied survey research mostly faces item nonresponse. Imputation fills in those missing values to restore the overall structure of a partially observed dataset and has its own well-defined evaluation criteria, which differ fundamentally from prediction accuracy. We present the first evaluation of LLM imputation against proper multiple-imputation metrics and statistical baselines on more than 5 million imputed responses from four public opinion surveys under various missingness mechanisms. We evaluate in-context learning (ICL) for this task by investigating 84 ICL configurations and comparing the best-performing configurations on six open-weight LLMs. The strongest ICL approach improves on zero-shot persona prompting but remains, at best, competitive with statistical baselines (MICE PMM, TabPFN). translated_title: 使用大语言模型对舆论数据进行插补
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常被评估作为调查问卷回答的模拟器，然而应用性调查研究主要面临的是题目无回答问题。插补通过填补这些缺失值来恢复部分观测数据集的整体结构，并有其自身明确的评估标准，这与预测准确率有着根本的不同。我们首次在多种缺失机制下，基于来自四项舆论调查的超过500万条插补回答，使用规范的多重插补评估指标和统计基线对LLM插补进行了评估。我们通过考察84种上下文学习（ICL）配置，并在六个开源权重LLM上比较表现最佳的配置，来评估ICL在该任务上的效果。最强的ICL方法优于零样本角色提示，但充其量也只能与统计基线方法（MICE PMM、TabPFN）相当。ICL方法对调查主题较为敏感，并且……
tldr: 本文首次采用规范的多重插补评估标准，在超过500万条舆论调查数据上系统评估了84种上下文学习配置的大语言模型插补方法，发现其最优表现仅能与MICE PMM、TabPFN等统计基线方法相当，且对调查主题高度敏感。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first evaluation of LLM-based imputation against proper multiple-imputation metrics and statistical baselines on over 5 million responses from four public opinion surveys, finding that the best in-context learning configuration is at best competitive with—rather than superior to—statistical baselines such as MICE PMM and TabPFN.
